content:
Hi all - I derive the Parseval/Plancherel identity for the discrete Fourier transform ZMod.dft and I don't see it in mathlib. Wanted to check if there was interest before opening a PR.

If so, I'd be happy to share or answer questions.

I proved this a while ago, and it's since been maintained and kept working by @Yaël Dillies here: https://github.com/YaelDillies/apap/blob/89c21be2ce29723dd77e78e9c58cfde584e49af2/APAP/Prereqs/FourierTransform/Discrete.lean#L64
Bhavik, since then it seems someone has added docs#ZMod.dft to mathlib? This unfortunately duplicates APAP material
Oh, I thought that was the version you added!
Well, if the implementations are effectively identical then it is unfortunate that double the work needed was spending building them
